reviews.body: Thanks, this checks out. Without `usage_object`, litellm 1.100.4 rebuilds a bare `Usage` with zero cache tokens, so cached prompt tokens were billed at the full input rate. I verified against the pinned litellm with both OpenAI-style usage (`prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens`) and Anthropic-style usage (cache read and cache creation, normalized by litellm). The new numbers match hand-computed pricing in both cases, with no double counting, and missing or `None` cache fields fall back to the old result. (I removed an internal tooling note that had ended up at the bottom of the PR description.)
